affected_party: Humans, AI agents, and hybrid organizations relying on calibrated QIF decisions
actual_problem: QIF can classify proceed or defer outcomes, but cannot represent governed human-review or specialist-escalation routes, their accountable authority, or their execution evidence.
why_it_matters: Binary routing hides where judgment or specialist capability is required and can turn a probability threshold into implicit authority.
why_now: v0.6.34 exposed threshold brittleness; the next safe capability is explicit selective escalation before any policy optimization.
